en: Better late than never.
zh: 迟到总比不到好。

en: Oh, do I have food in my teeth?
zh: 哦，我牙上有食物残渣吗？

en: Whenever I clean my room, it always takes at least triple the time than I originally estimate.
zh: 每次我打扫房间，花的时间至少都是我原本预估的三倍。

en: I don't know if I just have like a bad gauge of time or
zh: 我不知道是我对时间的判断太差，还是

en: if I'm just like hopefully optimistic.
zh: 我就是有点盲目乐观。

en: but it looks so much better.
zh: 但现在看起来好多了。

en: I already feel so much more at peace.
zh: 我已经感觉内心平静多了。

en: Like there's just no better feeling than a clean room.
zh: 真的没有什么感觉比干净的房间更好了。

en: I just want to sit in my room and stare at it.
zh: 我就想坐在房间里盯着它看。

en: I'm such a visual person.
zh: 我是特别视觉型的人。

en: Like I need to have my space clean in order for my mind to feel clean.
zh: 我真的需要空间保持干净，脑子才会感觉清爽。

en: I already feel like 10 times better.
zh: 我已经感觉好了十倍。

en: I think I just want to chill the rest of the night.
zh: 我觉得今晚剩下的时间就想放松一下。

en: I feel like I was pretty productive today.
zh: 我感觉今天还是挺高效的。

en: As I was cleaning, I kind of gathered this bag together.
zh: 我打扫的时候，顺手把这一袋东西整理出来了。

en: I get sent so much stuff.
zh: 我收到的东西真的太多了。

en: I literally, it feels like Christmas for me every day.
zh: 说真的，对我来说每天都像过 Christmas 一样。

en: I'm the luckiest girl in the world.
zh: 我是世界上最幸运的女孩。

en: And I just know that someone else out there deserves this 10 times more than me.
zh: 而且我很清楚，外面一定有人比我更值得拥有这些东西。

en: I don't need any more stuff as much as I love Mario Badescu.
zh: 我不需要更多东西了，虽然我真的很喜欢 Mario Badescu。

en: So I thought, you know what?
zh: 所以我就想，你知道吗？

en: Why don't I just pick one of you guys to give this to?
zh: 我为什么不从你们当中选一个人，把这些送给她呢？

en: I won't go through everything, but some highlights.
zh: 我就不把所有东西都一一介绍了，但有几个重点。

en: Face spray, Mario Badescu face cleanser, their neck cream, niacinamide cream.
zh: 面部喷雾、Mario Badescu 洁面乳、他们家的颈霜、烟酰胺面霜。

en: Hyaluronic moisturizer, eye cream.
zh: 玻尿酸保湿霜、眼霜。

en: Just a few of the things.
zh: 这些只是其中一部分。

en: To enter, I just want to make it easy.
zh: 参与方式我想弄得简单一点。

en: Comment below the best piece of advice you've ever received.
zh: 在下面评论你收到过的最好的一条建议。

en: I am really asking that because I'm curious.
zh: 我是真的想问，因为我很好奇。

en: Also write your Instagram handles so that way.
zh: 也写上你们的 Instagram 账号，这样的话。

en: I can message you and pick the winner.
zh: 我就可以私信你，然后选出获奖者。

en: Anyways, I'm really here because I figured it was time to do another advice session.
zh: 总之，我今天主要是觉得差不多该再做一期答疑建议环节了。

en: You guys know the drill.
zh: 你们知道流程的。

en: If you follow me on Instagram and message me.
zh: 如果你关注了我的 Instagram，然后给我发消息。

en: I pick someone and it's totally anonymous.
zh: 我会选一个人，而且是完全匿名的。

en: I never say who sent me the DM.
zh: 我从来不会说是谁给我发的 DM。

en: And I just kind of like do my best to like help answer it or just like give my two cents.
zh: 然后我就尽力去回答，或者说说我的一点看法。

en: What made you decide to live so far away from your family and friends?
zh: 是什么让你决定住得离家人和朋友这么远？

en: Was it hard?
zh: 这难吗？

en: Do you have any advice or things you live by so you don't get overwhelmed with anxiety being so far away?
zh: 你有没有什么建议，或者有什么一直坚持的原则，能让你在离他们这么远的时候不被焦虑压垮？

en: I specifically wanted to answer this question.
zh: 我特别想回答这个问题。

en: because it's been something I've been really honestly like struggling with.
zh: 因为说实话，这也是我最近一直挺挣扎的一件事。

en: As some of you guys know, I'm from Minnesota.
zh: 你们有些人知道，我来自 Minnesota。

en: and I didn't initially decide to like move away to get away from my family or friends.
zh: 我一开始并不是为了远离家人或朋友才决定搬走的。

en: It was more of a consequence of just where I wanted to live.
zh: 更多只是因为我想住的地方刚好在那里。

en: Was it not by them?
zh: 而不是在他们身边。

en: I haven't lived by my family in six years now.
zh: 我已经六年没住在家人附近了。

en: I was in California and now I'm living in New York.
zh: 之前我在 California，现在我住在 New York。

en: I thought it would get easier as I got older.
zh: 我本来以为随着年龄增长，这会变得更容易。

en: And to be honest, it has not.
zh: 但说实话，并没有。

en: I don't know why I thought it would get easier.
zh: 我不知道自己为什么会觉得它会变容易。

en: but every time I leave them, like after a visit, I feel like for the next two,
zh: 但每次我探望完他们离开之后，接下来的两天，

en: three days, I am really, really sad.
zh: 三天里，我都会非常非常难过。

en: It takes me like a good week to kind of like get out of that funk.
zh: 我差不多要花整整一周，才能慢慢从那种低落状态里走出来。

en: I think whenever I find myself feeling like anxious about it and sad about not being close to them,
zh: 我觉得每当我因为这件事感到焦虑，因为不能住得离他们近而难过的时候，

en: I remember first of all that I can FaceTime and I'm like so grateful
zh: 我首先会提醒自己，我可以 FaceTime，而且我真的非常感激

en: that FaceTime exists.
zh: FaceTime 的存在。

en: I think about like 30 years ago when that wasn't an option.
zh: 我会想，如果是 30 年前，这根本就不是一个选项。

en: I also try to remind myself to feel grateful for the fact
zh: 我也会提醒自己，要为这件事感到感恩，

en: that I miss my family because I know.
zh: 那就是我会想念我的家人，因为我知道。

en: there's a lot of people who don't have good relationships with their family members.
zh: 有很多人和自己的家人关系并不好。

en: and I'm so lucky to like be in the position to miss them.
zh: 而我能处在一个会想念他们的位置，其实真的很幸运。

en: It just means that I love them and I have such a great relationship with them.
zh: 这只是说明我爱他们，而且我和他们的关系非常好。

en: So I found it's a bit more of my perspective.
zh: 所以我发现，这更多是一种看待事情的角度。

en: and I think the biggest thing too is whenever I leave them or we separate.
zh: 而且我觉得另一件最重要的事是，每当我离开他们，或者我们分开的时候。

en: I try to already have the next trip planned to see them.
zh: 我会尽量提前安排好下一次见他们的行程。

en: So that way it's a little bit less hard because I know exactly
zh: 这样就会稍微没那么难受，因为我很清楚地知道

en: when I'm going to see them next.
zh: 下一次什么时候能见到他们。

en: But yeah, I mean, to be honest, sometimes it's hard.
zh: 不过是的，说实话，有时候真的很难。

en: and I'm not going to like pretend that it's totally easy because it's definitely not for me.
zh: 我也不想假装这件事完全很轻松，因为对我来说绝对不是。

en: I have plenty of nights where I like honestly get so sad and I just miss being close to them.
zh: 有很多个晚上，我真的会特别难过，只是很想念住在他们身边的感觉。

en: I also feel like weirdly guilty for leaving my family.
zh: 我还会莫名其妙地因为离开家人而感到内疚。

en: I don't know if anyone relates to that.
zh: 我不知道有没有人能理解这种感觉。

en: The older I get, I just feel wrong for not living by them.
zh: 年纪越大，我越觉得不住在他们身边好像不太对。

en: My family doesn't make me feel like that.
zh: 我的家人并没有让我产生这种感觉。

en: They support me living my life, but I don't know.
zh: 他们支持我过自己的人生，但我不知道。

en: I feel so guilty about it.
zh: 我就是对此特别内疚。

en: On that note, I'm going to do some skincare.
zh: 说到这里，我要去做点护肤了。

en: Well, I just did skincare.
zh: 好吧，其实我刚刚已经护肤了。

en: but I'm going to put on my red light mask.
zh: 但我要戴上我的红光面罩。

en: and I think I'm going to watch the game.
zh: 然后我想我会看比赛。

en: Just a cute little, I just want a cute little cozy night for myself alone.
zh: 就是一个可可爱爱的，我只想自己一个人过一个温馨舒服的小夜晚。
